title: Letter Case Permutation
description:
You are given a string s.

For each letter in the string:

You can change it to lowercase or uppercase

Digits remain unchanged.

Task

Return all possible strings formed by changing the case of letters.

Important Points
Each letter has 2 choices → lower or upper
Digits stay the same
Total combinations = 2^(number of letters)
Examples

Example 1

s = "a1b2"
→ ["a1b2","a1B2","A1b2","A1B2"]

Example 2

s = "3z4"
→ ["3z4","3Z4"]
Constraints
1 ≤ s.length ≤ 12
s contains:
letters (a–z, A–Z)
digits (0–9)
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
